Main chart = Current Symbol / Current TF;

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Daily Reset (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------

{

    // Action #3

    // Action #6
    TP_Active = AssignVrbVleEntMlt1;
}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: InitRange (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if (((barcount = 0)
   and (Bar Hour[0] = 8))
   and (Bar Minute[0] >= 1))
{
    // Action #1
    h = High(Main chart)[1];
    // Action #2
    l = Low(Main chart)[1];
    // Action #3
    barcount = AssignVrbVleEntMlt2;
    // Action #4
    Rangeready = False;
}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: UpdateRange (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if (Not Rangeready
   and ((barcount < Openrangeminutes)
   and (barcount > 0)))
{
    // Action #1
    h = Maximum(h, High(Main chart)[0]);
    // Action #2
    l = Minimum(l, Low(Main chart)[0]);
    // Action #3
    barcount = (barcount + AssignVrbVleEntMlt2);
}

    RDD_factor = AssignVrbVleEntMlt5;

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: FreezeRange (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if (Not Rangeready
   and (barcount >= Openrangeminutes))
{
    // Action #1
    sigma = StdDev(Main chart,Openrangeminutes, PRICE_CLOSE)[1];
    // Action #2
    Bu = (h + (epsilon1 * sigma));
    // Action #3
    Bl = (l - (epsilon2 * sigma));
    // Action #4
    SL = (TSL * (Bu - Bl));
    // Action #5
    Rangeready = True;
}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Trading signals (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
LongEntrySignal = ((((Rangeready
   and (High(Main chart)[1] > Bu))
   and (Bar Hour[0] >= 8))
   and (Bar Minute[0] >= 30))
   and (Bar Hour[0] < 16));

ShortEntrySignal = ((((Rangeready
   and (Low(Main chart)[1] < Bl))
   and (Bar Hour[0] >= 8))
   and (Bar Minute[0] >= 30))
   and (Bar Hour[0] < 16));

LongExitSignal = false;

ShortExitSignal = false;


//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Long entry (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if (LongEntrySignal
   and (MarketPosition("Current", MagicNumber, "") is Flat))
{
    // Action #1
    Open Long order at Market;
        Duplicate trades: disabled;
        Stop Loss at level (OrderOpenPrice("Current", MagicNumber, 1, "") - SL);

    // Action #2
    max_price = OrderOpenPrice("Current", MagicNumber, 1, "");
}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Short entry (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if (ShortEntrySignal
   and (MarketPosition("Current", MagicNumber, "") is Flat))
{
    // Action #1
    Open Short order at Market;
        Duplicate trades: disabled;
        Stop Loss at level (OrderOpenPrice("Current", MagicNumber, -1, "") + SL);

    // Action #2
    min_price = OrderOpenPrice("Current", MagicNumber, -1, "");
}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Upadte_Max_price (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if (MarketPosition("Current", MagicNumber, "") <> 0)
{
    // Action #1
    max_price = Maximum(max_price, High(Main chart)[0]);
    // Action #2
    min_price = Minimum(min_price, Low(Main chart)[0]);
}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Activate_TP (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if (((MarketPosition("Current", MagicNumber, "") > 0)
   and (TP_Active = 0))
   and ((Close(Main chart)[0] - OrderOpenPrice("Current", MagicNumber, 1, "")) >= (TP_threshold_factor * (Bu - Bl))))
{
    // Action #1
    TP_Active = AssignVrbVleEntMlt2;
}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Activate_TP_short (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if (((MarketPosition("Current", MagicNumber, "") < 0)
   and (TP_Active = 0))
   and ((OrderOpenPrice("Current", MagicNumber, -1, "") - Close(Main chart)[0]) >= (TP_threshold_factor * (Bu - Bl))))
{
    // Action #1
    TP_Active = AssignVrbVleEntMlt2;
}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Exit_RDD (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if ((((TP_Active = 1)
   and (Bars Since Order Open("Current", MagicNumber, 0, "") > 0))
   and (((Close(Main chart)[0] <= (max_price - (RDD_factor * (max_price - OrderOpenPrice("Current", MagicNumber, 1, "")))))
   and (MarketPosition("Current", MagicNumber, "") > 0))
   or  ((Close(Main chart)[0] >= (min_price + (RDD_factor * (OrderOpenPrice("Current", MagicNumber, -1, "") - min_price))))
   and (MarketPosition("Current", MagicNumber, "") < 0))))
   and (Open PL in Pips("Current", MagicNumber, 0, "") > 0))
{
    // Action #1
    Close all positions for Symbol = Current and Magic Number = MagicNumber;

    // Action #2
    TP_Active = AssignVrbVleEntMlt1;
}
